dialogue_texts: My, what a curious little trinket.
To weave the boundaries of 'forward' and 'backward' into such a fragile charm...
It has a certain quaint, terrestrial charm.
It's a spatial-inversion charm, but the lingering spiritual pressure is exceptionally dense.
The master who wove this boundary is close.
Calling my craft a 'quaint trinket' while wandering blindly through my parallel pathways?
You possess a remarkably haughty tongue, My Majesty.
Oh, so you are the weaver of these distorted mirrors?
Tell me, little architect, why freeze the flow of time and warp these axes?
A night that never ends loses its novelty if the scenery refuses to change.
Tonight, the architectural axes and parallel timelines bend strictly to my whim.
Let us see if you can maintain your royal composure when 'forward' and 'backward' dissolve entirely!
